events.verdict: Prince (MIL) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Siakam (IND) before incidental hand contact occurs thereafter on the shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) firms up and absorbs the contact that occurs with Lopez (MIL) during the screen.
Nesmith (IND) has a bent forearm on Kuzma (MIL), which he does not extend as they come together underneath the basket during the long rebound.
Toppin (IND) briefly engages with Lopez (MIL) off-ball as he attempts to defend the pass.
Nembhard (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Lopez (MIL) during the steal attempt.
Nembhard (IND) deflects the ball out of bounds. Possession correctly stays with Milwaukee.
Lopez (MIL) clamps and holds Nesmith's (IND) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.

Nesmith (IND) contests the shot attempt and grazes Porter Jr.'s (MIL) hand after his release, which is marginal. He appears to contest in front of Porter Jr. as well, avoiding any body contact following the release.
Lopez (MIL) and Toppin (IND) mutually engage and subsequently disengage during the rebound.
Haliburton (IND) commits a take foul on Prince (MIL).
Nembhard (IND) quickly slides his hand off of Lillard's (MIL) arm as he attempts to defend around the screen.
Lopez (MIL) firms up in Nembhard's (IND) path and absorbs the contact that occurs during the screen.

Siakam (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Lillard (MIL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring. Siakam deflects the ball into the backcourt and Lillard legally retrieves it.
Haliburton (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Lillard (MIL) during the steal.
Siakam (IND) commits a take foul on Prince (MIL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Porter Jr. (MIL) briefly grasps and quickly releases Haliburton's (IND) arm as he attempts to defend the inbounds pass.

Replay review of the foul called on Nesmith (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. After review, the foul called on Nesmith (IND) was corrected to be called on Nembhard (IND). Nembhard reaches in and comes across Prince's (MIL) right arm, causing him to fall out of bounds.
Nesmith (IND) commits a take foul on Porter Jr. (MIL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
